items.title: Adding the Context Streaming Events Need: Reference Data Joins with OneLake Delta Tables in Fabric Eventstream
items.text: Enrich events with business context in real time, enabling faster decisions, more relevant alerts, and lower operational effort downstream. A real-time event tells you what happened. Context tells you what it means—and what to do next. In cold-chain logistics, a temperature reading becomes actionable when paired with a shipment’s temperature limits, customer priority, and response contacts. Reference Data Join in Fabric Eventstream brings that context to live events by matching them with business information from Delta tables in OneLake before they reach downstream destinations—so consumers can understand and act on the events without performing separate lookups. The scenario: Cold chain logistics Cold chain logistics moves temperature-sensitive goods, such as fresh produce, dairy, frozen foods, and pharmaceuticals, from origin to destination within strict temperature ranges. Refrigerated trailers, containers, and warehouses must keep products in range at every stage. A few degrees off…
